item1.q: Does the system support mobile devices and tablets?
item1.a: Yes, SmartWare interface is fully responsive using Bootstrap and React.

item2.q: How is warehouse and shipment data secured?
item2.a: Connected to Laravel backend via REST APIs secured with JWT/Sanctum authentication.

item3.q: Can multiple warehouses be added under one account?
item3.a: Yes, Super Admin can create multiple warehouses and assign a Warehouse Admin for each.
